$comment: Cloudflare Custom WAF rules for ReconIQ. Apply via `wrangler` or the dashboard under Security > WAF > Custom rules. Rules are evaluated top-to-bottom.

rules.description: mkt-admin geo restriction — challenge non-approved regions
Public API POST — challenge medium-threat traffic
rules.expression: starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/public") and http.request.method eq "POST" and cf.threat_score gt 20

rules.description: Block secret leakage in request bodies
rules.expression: starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and (http.request.body.raw contains "sb_secret_" or http.request.body.raw contains "SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE")

rules.description: Rate-limit API surface (300 r/min per IP)
Copilot stream — 30 r/min per session cookie
Bypass cron allow-list for public hooks
